newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends busy day stronger.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends busy day stronger.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar ended a busy, volatile day stronger on Thursday at C$1.3291 (US$0.7524), dealers said.
* They said the currency swung up and down with in its range to close at the strong end on large two-way flows.
* Most of the trading was the result of big changes in the U.S. dollar versus the mark and yen, dealers said.
Canada's volatility was linked to swings in the U.S. dollar versus the yen and mark, dealers said.
Trends in foreign currency will likely dominate the Canadian dollar again Friday, although the market will be watching for October unemployment numbers.
The market is also bracing for another Bank of Canada rate cut on Friday if unemployment numbers are high, but a cut will probably not affect the currency, dealers said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar slid to 1.1378 marks from Wednesday's close at 1.1392 marks and dropped to 84.39 yen from 85.56 yen on Wednesday.
